# **Submission Rules**

- **We welcome runners of all skill levels to submit their runs, no matter their RTA time.** As such, there is no "RTA floor."
- Any version is allowed.
- Runs done on versions 1.0.0-1.0.2 are not allowed to use the Invincibility glitch unless the run is being submitted to the Legacy board.
- Runs done on versions 1.x.x will be rejected if submitted with the Rookie or Dread Mode difficulties.  
- Each run may only be submitted once across all categories, and it must be tagged with the most accurate category/variables. For example, a run collecting all items must be submitted to the 100% board, it may not be submitted to Any%. Inaccurately tagging your run (knowingly or unknowingly) can result in your run being rejected.

# **Setting up a "Run File"**

To set up a run file, watch the intro of the game and then go back to the main menu. This will give you a file that skips the intro every time you do a run.

# **Verifying a "Run File"**

To verify that your run file is valid, load the file from the "Load Game" menu. **If, after the loading screen has passed, Samus is in the Artaria "Basement" with 99 energy, zero Power Bombs, and 30 (Rookie) or 15 (Normal, Hard, Dread) missiles, no bosses beaten, no major upgrades collected, and no doors opened, your run file is considered valid for leaderboard purposes.** ([See this pic for reference.](https://proof.hijumpboots.com/image/pz3wmGpWm3S#))

*Note: if using the honor system (see "Still Image Proof" below), you do not need to submit a screenshot of Samus in the starting area.*

# Proof Requirements (please read CAREFULLY)

In all cases, **you must submit some sort of proof that you achieved the time you did in order for your run to be accepted to the leaderboards.** However, we often allow lower-ranking runners to submit proof on the "honor system" by submitting a still image with their In-Game Time (IGT) displayed as proof. Please check [this page](https://dreadwiki.hijumpboots.com/en/rules#video-proof-thresholds) or the specific category you are running to see if you are eligible to submit still image proof.

## **Still Image Proof ("honor system")**

Please see the following list for the IGT proof you need:

- Full Game runs: upload a screenshot of the "Clear Time" or "Mission Result" screens.
- Boss Rush complete runs: upload a screenshot of the "Boss Rush Complete" or "Dread Rush Complete" screens.
- Individual level (IL) challenges: contiguous video footage is always required.

*Note: the screenshots listed above are the only screenshots that need to be submitted. Other still images ("proof of run file", "proof of starting location") are not necessary.*

### **Accepted Image Hosts for Still Image Proof**

The only acceptable image host for IGT proof is "Proof", our community-managed image host. See [this news post](https://www.speedrun.com/mdread/news/430p0wx5) for more insight as to why we made this decision. **Going forward, use of any external image host (including Discord, public social media, or cloud-based storage services that allow hotlinking from external sites, such as OneDrive or Google Drive) will result in your run being rejected.** Use only the service below to host your proof.

### [https://proof.hijumpboots.com](https://proof.hijumpboots.com)

## **Video Proof**

If you are required to submit video proof, all video proof must have complete, contiguous game footage with no audio or video dropouts of any kind, and energy and ammo counts visible for the entirety of the run. Specific requirements for different challenges on the leaderboards are as follows:

- Full game runs must have footage of the "Clear Time" or "Mission Result" screens at the end of the run.
- Boss Rush runs must have footage of the "Boss Rush Complete" or "Dread Rush Complete" screens at the end of the Rush.
- Boss Rush Individual Level (IL) challenges must have footage of the "Boss Rush Practice" or "Dread Rush Practice" screens at the **end** of an individual practice attempt (*after* you have defeated the boss you are challenging). If your level and your end screen both fit within the Nintendo Switch video capture maximum video length (30 seconds), you may submit videos recorded on the Switch itself. You may not stitch multiple Nintendo Switch video clips together for submission. If your footage is longer than 30 seconds, please use a capture card instead.

---

### Videos with Incomplete Footage

If your run has audio or video dropouts and **it is an exceptional case** (for example, your run achieved a top 3 time in a challenging category and you lost two seconds or less of A/V footage over the course of the entire run), please consult a Community Manager in the Discord or send an SRC direct message to a Super Moderator for further instructions.

If the verifier team decides to proceed, you should expect your run to be subjected to a rigorous and detailed analysis during which the verifier team will collect circumstantial evidence that supports the case that your run is genuinely contiguous and should be verified in spite of missing footage. This process is significantly more in-depth than normal verification, and may take several days longer than the normal lead time for a run to be verified, since a volunteer needs to handle the case and collect evidence.

*Note: The verification team does not guarantee that we will verify your run if it has A/V dropouts, but we might be able to work with what you have if your run pushes the envelope in some way and you are only missing a few moments of footage in one or two spots.*

# **Other Rules**

- Emulators are not allowed.
- Use of Amiibos is not allowed.
- Third-party controllers are allowed.
- [Macros](https://dreadwiki.hijumpboots.com/en/controllers/glossary#macro) are not allowed.
- Game mods (functional or cosmetic), or other programs that modify in-game memory or game assets are not allowed.
- [Turbo](https://dreadwiki.hijumpboots.com/en/controllers/glossary#turbo) controllers with a raw shot fire speed of up to 21Hz are allowed. Please consult [the Guides section](https://www.speedrun.com/mdread/guides) for suitable controllers.
- Use of the 73-hour idle strategy to obtain [Hyper Mode](https://dreadwiki.hijumpboots.com/en/tricks/hyper-mode) and shorten missile cooldown time is not allowed. 4½-hour idle and 9-hour idle are allowed.
- Rebinding controls using the Switch “Change Button Mapping” menu is allowed.
- In categories with [restricted glitches](https://dreadwiki.hijumpboots.com/en/rules#glitches-vs-exploits), glitch usage can be overlooked in the event that it is fully accidental and non-beneficial. If movement was skipped as a result of your glitch, you must go back and execute the movement you would have missed. If you are unsure, you should load your last checkpoint to be safe.

newsList.body: Hey Everyone, in response to Twitch's announced 100 hour highlight storage limit going into effect on April 19th 2025, we have decided to disallow the use of Twitch highlights as a valid video submission to our boards. This will go into effect on April 19th and will only apply to runs going forward!

# **Objective**

# **Timing**

values.rules:
# **Objective**

Beat the game as fast as possible. 

# **Timing**

Timing starts the **first time** you select Continue on **any file** in the File Selection screen, and timing ends on the first frame of the cutscene during the escape sequence where Samus is running to her ship, played on a run file. (See the game rules for info on how to set up a run file.)

# Pre-Skew

Starting a run while already in the Axis Skew state is permitted, as well as achieving an Axis Skew state mid-run by loading a save file, achieving the state, and continuing on with your original save file. However, you may not use the Boss Rush mode to achieve an Axis Skew state.

values.name: No Major Glitches
values.rules:
# **Objective**

Beat the game **without using major glitches**.

# **Timing**

Timing starts when you select Continue on a run file (see the game rules for info on how to set up a run file), and timing ends on the first frame of the cutscene during the escape sequence where Samus is running to her ship, played on that same run file. **Loading any file other than the one selected at the start of the run footage invalidates the run.**

# Glitch Restrictions

The **No Major Glitches** glitch classification is defined as follows:

> Any glitch that allows Samus to move entirely into collision is disallowed. You can easily check what is considered an out-of-bounds (OoB) collision by seeing if it's possible for Samus to die in it.

This includes the following glitches:

- Aim Down Clipping
- Camera Lock
- Grappling magnets through walls
- Ledge Climb Clipping
- Reverse Magnet
- Slope Clipping
- Shine Sink Clipping

Instances of collision updating, failing to update, or respawning do not invalidate a glitch. It is possible to die with Pseudo-Waves and Ledge Warps this way, but they do not allow you to directly clip out of bounds.

In addition, any glitch that results in Samus's rotation suffering a lasting displacement is disallowed. This includes:

- Any kind of Axis Skew
- Upside-Down Samus

If you are unsure if a glitch is allowed, consult the Discord server.

values.name: Glitchless
values.rules:
# **Objective**

Beat the game **without using any of the techniques in the "Banned Techniques" list.**

# **Timing**

Timing starts when you select Continue on a run file (see the game rules for info on how to set up a run file), and timing ends on the first frame of the cutscene during the escape sequence where Samus is running to her ship, played on that same run file. **Loading any file other than the one selected at the start of the run footage invalidates the run.**

# **Banned Techniques**

- Aim Down Clipping
- Air Walking
- Axis Skew
- Camera Lock
- Grappling magnets through walls
- Invincibility
- Ledge Climb Clipping
- Ledge Warping
- Pseudo Wave
- Reverse Grapple
- Reverse Magnet
- Shine Sink Clipping
- Short Boosting
- Slope Clipping
- Upside-Down Samus
- Water Bomb Jumping

See [this guide](https://www.speedrun.com/mdread/guide/c0aa9) for glitch classification information. If you are unsure if a technique is allowed, consult the Discord server.

games.rules:
# **Submission Rules**

- **We welcome runners of all skill levels to submit their runs, no matter their RTA time.** As such, there is no "RTA floor."
- Any version is allowed.
- Runs done on versions 1.0.0-1.0.2 are not allowed to use the Invincibility glitch unless the run is being submitted to the Legacy board.
- Runs done on versions 1.x.x will be rejected if submitted with the Rookie or Dread Mode difficulties.  
- Each run may only be submitted once across all categories, and it must be tagged with the most accurate category/variables. For example, a run collecting all items must be submitted to the 100% board, it may not be submitted to Any%. Inaccurately tagging your run (knowingly or unknowingly) can result in your run being rejected.

# **Setting up a "Run File"**

To set up a run file, watch the intro of the game and then go back to the main menu. This will give you a file that skips the intro every time you do a run.

# **Verifying a "Run File"**

To verify that your run file is valid, load the file from the "Load Game" menu. **If, after the loading screen has passed, Samus is in the Artaria "Basement" with 99 energy, zero Power Bombs, and 30 (Rookie) or 15 (Normal, Hard, Dread) missiles, no bosses beaten, no major upgrades collected, and no doors opened, your run file is considered valid for leaderboard purposes.** ([See this pic for reference.](https://proof.hijumpboots.com/image/pz3wmGpWm3S#))

*Note: if using the honor system (see "Still Image Proof" below), you do not need to submit a screenshot of Samus in the starting area.*

# Proof Requirements (please read CAREFULLY)

In all cases, **you must submit some sort of proof that you achieved the time you did in order for your run to be accepted to the leaderboards.** However, we often allow lower-ranking runners to submit proof on the "honor system" by submitting a still image with their In-Game Time (IGT) displayed as proof. Please check [this page](https://dreadwiki.hijumpboots.com/en/rules#video-proof-thresholds) or the specific category you are running to see if you are eligible to submit still image proof.

## **Still Image Proof ("honor system")**

Please see the following list for the IGT proof you need:

- Full Game runs: upload a screenshot of the "Clear Time" or "Mission Result" screens.
- Boss Rush complete runs: upload a screenshot of the "Boss Rush Complete" or "Dread Rush Complete" screens.
- Individual level (IL) challenges: contiguous video footage is always required.

*Note: the screenshots listed above are the only screenshots that need to be submitted. Other still images ("proof of run file", "proof of starting location") are not necessary.*

### **Accepted Image Hosts for Still Image Proof**

The only acceptable image host for IGT proof is "Proof", our community-managed image host. See [this news post](https://www.speedrun.com/mdread/news/430p0wx5) for more insight as to why we made this decision. **Going forward, use of any external image host (including Discord, public social media, or cloud-based storage services that allow hotlinking from external sites, such as OneDrive or Google Drive) will result in your run being rejected.** Use only the service below to host your proof.

### [https://proof.hijumpboots.com](https://proof.hijumpboots.com)

## **Video Proof**

If you are required to submit video proof, all video proof must have complete, contiguous game footage with no audio or video dropouts of any kind, and energy and ammo counts visible for the entirety of the run. Specific requirements for different challenges on the leaderboards are as follows:

- Full game runs must have footage of the "Clear Time" or "Mission Result" screens at the end of the run.
- Boss Rush runs must have footage of the "Boss Rush Complete" or "Dread Rush Complete" screens at the end of the Rush.
- Boss Rush Individual Level (IL) challenges must have footage of the "Boss Rush Practice" or "Dread Rush Practice" screens at the **end** of an individual practice attempt (*after* you have defeated the boss you are challenging). If your level and your end screen both fit within the Nintendo Switch video capture maximum video length (30 seconds), you may submit videos recorded on the Switch itself. You may not stitch multiple Nintendo Switch video clips together for submission. If your footage is longer than 30 seconds, please use a capture card instead.

---

### Videos with Incomplete Footage

If your run has audio or video dropouts and **it is an exceptional case** (for example, your run achieved a top 3 time in a challenging category and you lost two seconds or less of A/V footage over the course of the entire run), please consult a Community Manager in the Discord or send an SRC direct message to a Super Moderator for further instructions.

If the verifier team decides to proceed, you should expect your run to be subjected to a rigorous and detailed analysis during which the verifier team will collect circumstantial evidence that supports the case that your run is genuinely contiguous and should be verified in spite of missing footage. This process is significantly more in-depth than normal verification, and may take several days longer than the normal lead time for a run to be verified, since a volunteer needs to handle the case and collect evidence.

*Note: The verification team does not guarantee that we will verify your run if it has A/V dropouts, but we might be able to work with what you have if your run pushes the envelope in some way and you are only missing a few moments of footage in one or two spots.*

# **Other Rules**

- Emulators are not allowed.

Instances of collision updating, failing to update, or respawning do not invalidate a glitch. It is possible to die with Pseudo-Waves and Ledge Warps this way, but they do not allow you to directly clip out of bounds.

In addition, any glitch that results in Samus's rotation suffering a lasting displacement is disallowed. This includes:

- Any kind of Axis Skew
- Upside-Down Samus

If you are unsure if a glitch is allowed, consult the Discord server.

# **Turbo**

Turbo controllers up to 20Hz are allowed, as long as you mark your run as "Turbo" when submitting. The average turbo speed of the controller must not exceed 21Hz (to account for manufacturer errors and variance).

values.name: Unrestricted (Multi-File)
values.rules:
# **Objective**

- Beat the game while collecting no expansions. You may not collect any Missile Tanks, Missile+ Tanks, Energy Tanks, Energy Tank Parts, or Power Bomb Tanks.  
- Collecting major upgrades is allowed but not required.

# **Timing**

Timing starts the **first time** you select Continue on **any file** in the File Selection screen, and timing ends on the first frame of the cutscene during the escape sequence where Samus is running to her ship, played on a run file. (See the game rules for info on how to set up a run file.)

# Pre-Skew

Starting a run while already in the Axis Skew state is permitted, as well as achieving an Axis Skew state mid-run by loading a save file, achieving the state, and continuing on with your original save file. However, you may not use the Boss Rush mode to achieve an Axis Skew state.
